editor.skill_help.root.aquatic.limits: Vanilla ability_aquatic and both sides' prompts.
editor.skill_help.root.aquatic.placement: Vanilla prompt explanation indicates placement range, does not mean bypassing other placement rules or gaining environment effects.
editor.skill_help.root.aquatic.title: Aquatic
editor.skill_help.root.aquatic.usage: Can be played on both water and land lanes.
editor.skill_help.root.armor.limits: Original both sides' armored prompts' {0} and 13 root structures.
editor.skill_help.root.armor.placement: Values come from corresponding native parameters, help will not rewrite it; damage minimum, repeated stacking, and order with other protections still need actual verification.
editor.skill_help.root.armor.title: Armored
editor.skill_help.root.armor.usage: Reduces damage taken based on armored value.
editor.skill_help.root.attack_override.l: Original 422 Mountain Hazelnut / 423 Health Pea original text and root structures.
editor.skill_help.root.attack_override.p: Original card observation Counters.Value=2; unknown Value is not interpreted as any formula. Mountain Hazelnut's global effect also depends on its ability group, not automatically generated by the base card switch.
editor.skill_help.root.attack_override.u: Original Health Pea uses this structure to indicate that attack damage is replaced by health value when attacking.
editor.skill_help.root.attacks_in_all_la: Vanilla 463 Meteor Fruit text and AttacksInAllLanes root structure.
This is an attack range root ability, which does not automatically increase the damage value on each target; the priority of multiple range abilities is not determined based on the original text.
Vanilla Meteor Fruit description: Attack all five lanes.
editor.skill_help.block.attacks_only_in_: Not a general same lane/adjacent lane target query, nor just a displayed icon.
Declare only the root ability that attacks adjacent lanes.
editor.skill_help.root.attacks_only_in_a: Vanilla 660 Rotating Turnip text and root structure.

The ability of the entity is different from general adjacent lane target queries; water lane placement is controlled by other abilities such as amphibious, and is not automatically obtained due to this item.
Attack the two adjacent lanes, not attack the lane you are on.
editor.skill_help.root.deadly.limits: Original deadly prompt and 5 root structures.
editor.skill_help.root.deadly.placement: Whether the target actually receives damage and protection/settlement conditions are still handled by the engine; no damage source or hero is claimed to be applicable according to the prompt.
editor.skill_help.root.deadly.title: Deadly
editor.skill_help.root.deadly.usage: Original prompt: Eliminate plants or zombies that are damaged by it.
editor.skill_help.root_ability_help.entr: No item-by-item verification has been done; existing native values are retained, and no new or modified permissions are granted based on this help.
editor.skill_help.root.error: Card base root ability; specific values and additional skills are configured separately through corresponding entries.
editor.skill_blocks.labels.supplemental_: Root component in card entity.components, outside ability groups
editor.skill_help.block.evolution_restri: Not a regular skill group component; the queried object differs from the replacement card target.
Card base root component, using a dedicated evolution target entry point.
Limits the targets that can be used during evolution.
editor.skill_help.root_ability_help.fiel: The purpose and boundaries of this root ability are yet to be verified specifically.
The root ability of the card itself.
Original text and root structure are not equivalent to native resolution or match verification.
editor.skill_help.root.frenzy.limits: Original version both sides frenzy prompt and 15 root structures.
editor.skill_help.root.frenzy.placement: The vanilla keyword is Frenzy. The current Chinese interface uses an alternate label. Attack timing, repeated triggers, and interactions still need separate verification.
editor.skill_help.root.frenzy.title: Frenzy
editor.skill_help.root.frenzy.usage: Can reattack after eliminating an enemy unit.
editor.skill_help.root.multishot.limits: Original version's 133/606 card text and Multishot root structure.
editor.skill_help.root.multishot.placeme: Original version's Triple Shooter, Triangular Hat Acorn have the same description; it is not an additional attack count parameter. It should be understood separately from attacking only adjacent lanes and full lane attacks.
editor.skill_help.root.multishot.title: Multi Lane Attack
editor.skill_help.root.multishot.usage: Attack yourself and enemies on adjacent lanes.
editor.skill_help.root.plays_face_down.l: Based on vanilla gravestone hints for both sides and 41 root occurrences of PlaysFaceDown.
editor.skill_help.root.plays_face_down.p: PlaysFaceDown represents the grave stone card ability; FaceDown is the covered state. They are not the same original component; it is not equal to writing a running state to any object.
editor.skill_help.root.plays_face_down.u: Vanilla tip: Hidden under the gravestone until the trick phase.
editor.skill_help.root.splash_damage.lim: Vanilla splash damage tip and 6 root structures.
editor.skill_help.root.splash_damage.pla: Numerical values come from splash damage parameters; this range differs from multi-target attacks, and actual targets and combination resolution follow original rules.
editor.skill_help.root.splash_damage.usa: During attack, it will also deal specified damage to enemy units on adjacent lanes.
editor.skill_help.block.springboard.limi: Displaying only ability icons or using SpringboardedOnSelfQuery will not add this root ability.
editor.skill_help.block.springboard.plac: Entry point for card root abilities.
editor.skill_help.block.springboard.usag: Declare the fusion ability of the card body.
editor.skill_help.root.springboard.limit: Vanilla 645 Pumpkin Shell / 649 Sulfur Fungus Springboard text and 10 root structures; fusion effects see complete ability group.
editor.skill_help.root.springboard.place: It cannot be considered as a complete fusion skill merely by adding icons or SpringboardedOnSelfQuery. General Vanilla tooltip direction is ambiguous, this explanation follows the actual configuration of cards like Pumpkin Shell.
editor.skill_help.root.springboard.title: Fusion
editor.skill_help.root.springboard.usage: This card can be fused by another unit; specific fusion effects are configured by the ability group.
editor.skill_help.root.strikethrough.lim: Vanilla strike through tip and 14 root structures.
editor.skill_help.root.strikethrough.pla: Vanilla name is Penetration, and the current interface's Through is an alias; precise calculation with defense and other combinations is verified separately.
editor.skill_help.root.strikethrough.usa: Attack enemy units and enemy heroes on your own lane.
editor.skill_help.root.teamup.placement: This is an intrinsic card ability, distinct from a same-lane target filter in an ability group. Vanilla hints alone do not establish support for arbitrary sides or stacking counts.
editor.skill_help.root.teamup.title: Team Up
editor.skill_help.root.teamup.usage: Original plants can place two plants on the same lane.
editor.skill_help.root.truestrike.limits: Based on vanilla truestrike hints for both sides and 21 root structures.
editor.skill_help.root.truestrike.placem: The name may be understood as hit rate; this item's original description limits it to charge of the block slot, not to assume other attack or selection rules based on the name.
editor.skill_help.root.truestrike.title: Sure Hit
editor.skill_help.root.truestrike.usage: Will not charge the opponent's block slot.
editor.skill_help.root.untrickable.limit: Based on vanilla untrickable hints for both sides and 6 root structures.
editor.skill_help.root.untrickable.place: Currently referred to as the prevention of trick bags; this prompt does not assume environment, unit skills, or all non-attack effects are invalid.
editor.skill_help.root.untrickable.title: Prevent Trick
editor.skill_help.root.untrickable.usage: Vanilla Note: Not affected by the opponent's tribe cards.
